[[Trans World Airlines]] |location = |role =Employees |TV actor =See [[#Behind the scenes|below]] }} The '''airline ticket inspectors''' are people working at [[Camp McCarran|McCarran International Airport]] before the [[Great War]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Wrangler]]=== Airline ticket inspectors are only very briefly visible in the background of the airport, during [[The Ghoul|Cooper Howard]]'s arrival in [[New Vegas|Las Vegas]]. ===[[The Strip]]=== Airline ticket inspectors can be seen again in this episode, servicing airline stations such as [[Trans World Airlines]] (TWA), while Cooper plans to return home before his arrest by [[U.S. federal agent]]s at the airport. ==Appearances== The airline ticket inpectiors appear only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|13=205|16=208}} ==Behind the scenes== The airline ticket inspectors are portrayed by uncredited extras, including, but not limited to, [[James Darnborough]]. ==See also== * [[Airport traveler]]s {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
